summary: California Water Service Group filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to update an existing equity distribution agreement, reflecting the termination of Janney Montgomery Scott and addition of Huntington Securities as a sales agent. This is a routine administrative amendment to an at-the-market (ATM) offering program originally set up in May 2025 for up to $350 million of common stock, with no new shares being offered or terms changed. The filing does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. It is a standard shelf takedown prospectus supplement disclosing managerial changes among the selling agents.
